container.driver: psycopg 3.3.6 on the Bench image's Python 3.13

notes: <sandbox>/work in argv stands for a fresh scratch copy of this run's inputs/ folder, mounted at /w; the inputs are kept under inputs/ as they ran.
Each log is the container's stdout followed by its stderr. verdict_lines are the lines of the log the recorder keeps (content/audit/tools/record-exemplars.mjs), copied in log order.

<repo> in argv is the course repository at the commit the inputs' hashes name, mounted read-only at /r with PYTHONPATH=/r/bench, as RUN-sql-shape-validator and RUN-tlc-trace-validation mount it; inputs lists the files of it the run reads.

The server ran in postgres:18@sha256:74935e72241653ca55e0414067e6d8763aceb8a810eb51b452253ec3dcfc4336 on the user network ssrec-net-pg-shape-pair with --memory=6g; before the first driver started, the recorder waited until docker logs showed "database system is ready to accept connections" twice and pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 exited 0. argv lists the commands in order.

shape9.py runs labs/reference/sql-validator/validators.py's shape() and semantic() on two plans of statespace.labs.lab9's PLANS, with the roles of RUN-sql-shape-validator ($1 from, $2 to, $3 amount), and replays each scenario's instance with replay_plan (PostgreSQL) and source_transfer (the interpreter), as that run's record.py does. It runs with python3 -B, not -I, so that PYTHONPATH reaches the mounted bench package; [q0] lines are the server and the bound, shared by both cases.
